name: Sono Yome wa Hatsukoi o Shiranai
original_name: その許嫁(よめ)は初恋を知らない
source:
At age 16, the government assigns you a betrothed under the "Matchmaking System".
Starting this new semester, your perfect match will be transferring to your school!
Achieve romance with these girls who've never known first love!!

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12227]official website[/url]]
